Evenepoel wins record fourth consecutive world time-trial title

Belgian cyclist Remco Evenepoel won his record fourth consecutive men's individual time trial title at the UCI Road World Championships in Montreal on Sunday. Switzerland's Marlen Reusser defended her women's title on her 35th birthday. Evenepoel completed the 39.2 km circuit in a fast time.
